subject: cannonback
disposition: Disabled saddle-variant review candidate; installed model, saddle prop and mount geometry unchanged.
authorization: Standing owner direction 1 (Meshy, no generation cap); CLAUDE.md art rule (agent-drafted reference)

meshy_model_task.input_images_note: views from the concept task listed (front first)

concept_tasks.prompt: The SAME Cannonback turtle creature as the first image (blue scaled skin with cream belly and jaw, grey-stone shell plates with moss, bronze-stone water cannons on the shell), unchanged identity and proportions. Add a flat, low riding saddle plate set into the shell behind the cannon cluster: a broad flat seat in the style of the second image (worn brown leather, sage-green cloth pad, cream wool lining, steel buckles), strapped flush onto the rear shell so a 1.8 m rider can sit there. Clean painted colour blocks in blue, gold and stone, stylised creature-game look, not photoreal, not speckled. No red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Neutral four-legged standing pose, all four legs clearly separated from the body and each other, full body, plain neutral background.
concept_tasks.verdict: rejected: copied board speckle; tall saddle with handles/hoops

concept_tasks.prompt: The SAME Cannonback turtle creature as the first image (deep blue scaled skin, cream belly and jaw, grey-stone shell plates with moss, bronze-stone water cannons on the front of the shell), unchanged identity and proportions. Add a flat, low riding saddle plate on the rear shell, behind the cannon cluster: a broad, flat, low-profile seat pad with no handles, no rings and no hoops, made of worn brown leather with a sage-green cloth pad and cream wool lining edge (style of the second image), strapped flush onto the rear shell with two brown straps so a rider can sit there. Painted in clean, smooth colour blocks: smooth deep blue skin with simple large scales, cream-gold belly, smooth grey-stone shell; no speckle, no spots, no noise, no mottling. Stylised creature-game look, not photoreal. No red, maroon or oxblood anywhere. Neutral four-legged standing pose, all four legs clearly separated from the body and each other, full body, plain neutral background.
concept_tasks.verdict: chosen: clean blue/gold/stone colour blocks, flat saddle behind the cannon cluster

generation_verdict: Identity kept (blue skin, cream-gold belly/jaw, grey moss stone shell, bronze cannons), flat low saddle plate with straps on the rear shell behind the cannons; legs separated; clean colour blocks (style is more cartoon than the board hero, consistent with the retexture direction). Mesh bbox 1.31 x 1.25 x 1.89. Unrigged; separate mesh from the installed lod0.

fit.rule: central back/saddle top on the current seat line, never shorter than the installed body

deformation_check.method: assets/creatures/tetherbound/stormursa/source/v3/check_v3_deformation.py (bone rotated 30 deg about world X; median follow ratio of >0.9-weighted distal vertices)

fit_risks: Seat line fitted on the central back column (4.140 m); the top at the current mount column is 4.119 m, so mount_offset must be re-measured on this mesh before activation.
Saddle-variant mesh is a new full-body generation (body plus saddle), not an attachment; identity, rider contact and gameplay footprint (6.47 m long at 4.28 m tall) are unjudged.
